response.text: The second query was malformed and returned unhelpful output, but the third gives the key AP tie-out results. Two things stand out: invoice 285 (journal 1452) has journal totals of 19774.55 against INV_AMT 19756.55 (a 18.00 gap), invoice 647 (journal 2034) ties to CR but not DR, and invoice 801 is a negative credit memo posted with a positive journal. Let me check the duplicate-invoice test more loosely, since the earlier query may have normalised too narrowly, and look at invoice 1 (V0013-67522-1) against 801 (V0013-67522-1-CM).

arguments.sql: SELECT h."INV_ID", h."VEND_CD", h."INV_NO", h."INV_AMT", h."INV_DT", h."STAT_CD", h."JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" h WHERE h."INV_ID" IN (1, 285, 647, 801, 2430) OR h."INV_NO" LIKE 'V0013-67522%' OR UPPER(TRIM(h."INV_NO")) IN (SELECT UPPER(TRIM(x."INV_NO")) FROM "APINVH" x GROUP BY UPPER(TRIM(x."INV_NO")) HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
